result:
The conditions list was not meant to show visit-note diagnoses, and the fix is to filter it to problem-list items. The stale-cache fix that would have made them show up was closed.

**What the community decided**
- The stale-cache PR #3402 (ticket O3-5741) was closed. Its reviewer pointed to a Talk thread, "Why do we display diagnoses in the conditions list" (talk.openmrs.org/t/…/49608/4), and said diagnoses no longer belong in the Conditions table. The ticket itself was flagged as needing correction. I could not open the Talk thread, since it is outside Falkon, so this comes from the PR comments.
- The merged replacement, PR #3403, adds a `problem-list-item` category filter to the conditions query. Its description says this keeps encounter diagnoses from the visit note out of the Conditions table. The same change touches `routes.json`.

**What else had to change so the diagnoses still show with the right visit**
- Diagnoses stay on the visit through their encounters. `mapEncounter` keeps each encounter's diagnoses and its `visitUuid`, and drops voided ones.
- PR #3496 (O3-5822) fixed the per-visit rollups. The visit history "Diagnoses" column and the visit summary repeated a diagnosis once per encounter. It now dedupes across the visit's encounters, keeping the lowest rank and strongest certainty. Encounter-level records are unchanged.
- PR #3621 (O3-5823) is related: it makes certainty and rank deterministic when a diagnosis is recorded in the visit note.

I found no PR that explicitly addresses "the right visit" beyond these. I ran out of the ten search calls before I could check further.
